answer: According to our offer-validity article, an offer is good for 300 additional miles or 7 days, whichever comes first, so an offer from December 2025 would have expired after 7 days even if you drove fewer than 300 miles. That article is dated 2022, so a store can confirm the exact terms on your December 2025 offer, which were also shown on your offer page and in your confirmation email. You can request a new offer at any time, and the amount will reflect current market prices, so it may be higher or lower.
